   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, October 15, 2019

  CALL TO ORDER
  ROLL CALL: Mayor Pu, Vice Mayor Menchaca, Council Members Costanzo, Liao,
  Harrington

1.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  Pursuant to provisions of the Government Code §54957, this is the time provided
  for members of the public to address the City Council regarding matters on this
  Agenda.

2.  CLOSED SESSION

  A. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – POTENTIAL/PENDING LITIGATION

  The Council will meet in a closed session with legal counsel to discuss a matter
  that the City Attorney has determined poses a significant exposure to litigation
  pursuant to Government Code §54956.9(c) - (one potential case).

3.  ADJOURN COUNCIL MEETING

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, October 15, 2019
  at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San
  Gabriel, California. Information regarding matters to be considered at each
  meeting will be available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the
  City’s website at www.sangabrielcity.com.

MINUTES OF OCTOBER 15, 2019
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Pu called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 5:31 p.m.
  on Tuesday, October 15, 2019, in Conference Room A at City Hall, 425 South Mission
  Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Juli Costanzo, John R. Harrington, Vice Mayor Denise
  Menchaca, and Mayor Jason Pu.
  Council Members Absent:  Chin Ho Liao.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto; City Attorney Keith
  Lemieux; Human Resources/Risk Management Director
  Edward Macias; and Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark.

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT - None.

I  2. CLOSED SESSION

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 5:31 p.m.

  A. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - POTENTIAL/PENDING LITIGATION
  (Government Code §54956.9[c]) - (one potential case).

  There was no reportable action.

  3. ADJOURNMENT

  The City Council meeting was adjourned at 6:03 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted :

  .~7~
I  SHARON F. CLARK, Chief City Clerk

  Approved this 5th day of November, 2019:

  JA  NPlJ,Mayor
